name: Zipporah
summary: A daughter of the priest of Midian, given to Moses as his wife after he helped her and her sisters at a well. On the way to Egypt she circumcised her son when the LORD met him and sought to kill him.

key_moments.title: Given to Moses as His Wife
key_moments.description: Shepherds drove Zipporah and her six sisters away from the well, but Moses stood up and helped them water their father's flock. Their father took Moses in and gave him Zipporah, and she bore him a son, Gershom.

key_moments.title: Circumcises Her Son on the Way
key_moments.description: At the inn on the road to Egypt, the LORD met him and sought to kill him. Zipporah took a sharp stone, cut off her son's foreskin, and said, A bloody husband art thou to me. So the LORD let him go.

key_moments.title: Brought Back to Moses by Jethro
key_moments.description: Moses had sent Zipporah back to her father. After the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, Jethro brought her and her two sons to Moses in the wilderness at the mount of God.
